frame.description: EYLRIM classic thick square acetate frame

coordinate_system.origin: bridge of the nose, front face of the frame (no microphone here in the two-mic layout)
coordinate_system.y: positive in front of the wearer
coordinate_system.plane: horizontal (x, y only); z/elevation not modeled yet
coordinate_system.angle_convention: 0 deg straight ahead, increasing clockwise toward the right; +90 right, -90 left, +/-180 behind; angle = atan2(x, y)

array.measurable: left/right angle only (-90 to +90 deg); front and back are mirror images across the M1-M2 axis and cannot be distinguished
array.note: For distant sources the direction is the same from the bridge origin and the array center. M0 (nose bridge, 0, 0) can be added later to resolve front/back.

microphones.note: x: replace with half the worn tip-to-tip spacing. y: replace with measured bridge-to-capsule distance, glasses lying flat.
Mirror of M1; measure separately in case mounting is asymmetric.

reference_points.note: From size code (about 6 mm frame past each lens) and product photo; not used by localization.
